status: FIRST RED: implicit Clang compilation directory remained clone-specific
diagnostic: product_build_id differed while profile_build_id was byte-identical

interpretation_correction.preserved_observation: nine C bitcode modules differed only in inline-assembly !srcloc metadata before LTO
interpretation_correction.disproved_interpretation: checkout-absolute forced-header/include arguments were the remaining cause
interpretation_correction.proof: Converting all checkout-owned forced-header and include-directory arguments to relative paths produced the identical pair of divergent media identities and roles.

cause: The Clang driver independently injected clone-absolute -fdebug-compilation-dir and -fcoverage-compilation-dir values into cc1. Those were the sole cc1-command differences after checkout-owned source, object, header and include arguments had become relative. llvm-mos propagated that directory-specific SourceLocation space into inline-assembly !srcloc metadata and full-LTO layout.
correction: Canonical compilation explicitly pins file, debug and coverage compilation directories to '.'. The resolved profile records deterministic_compilation_dir=. alongside the existing ordered-object, RNG, thread, llvm-link and ASLR controls.
